purpose: AI composition reference; exact coordinates and curves use the Python figures
prompt:
Create a NEW flat 2D academic scheduling schematic in Chinese, wide landscape, clean white background, restrained colors and generous spacing. This is a composition reference, not a numerical result. NO 3D, NO factories, NO algorithms or method names, NO BPC/Benders/network diagrams, NO optimality claims. Follow a user's simple Gantt-chart sketch: explain WHAT the scheduling problem is, with per-job input and decision annotations and a magnified example tied to the loss curve.
Three columns correspond to three DIFFERENT objectives, headings exactly "ET：提前／拖期时间", "计数型：事件与多档罚金", "Work：窗口外加工量". Each column repeats two parallel machine lanes M1/M2 with the same six colored jobs J1,J3,J5 on M1 and J2,J4,J6 on M2. Use colored processing rectangles with p_j labels and black completion dots C_j at the rectangle right endpoints. Above selected jobs J1,J3,J5, draw distinct slim tracks: gray dashed permissible range [A_j,B_j], green chosen promise [e_j,d_j] inside, and a width caliper D_j. Leave other jobs simple to avoid crowding. Label one short line "给定窗口／范围内决策窗口／随机工时下共享窗口" to indicate the three problem settings without methods.
Middle of each column magnifies J3 only: show a green promise interval [e,d] and an orange processing interval [S,C] on the same time coordinate. Cost labels rho(e-A) for later promise and lambda(D-Dmin) for extra width are small annotations on the promise rail, not processing costs. Draw separate alternative early and late positions of J3, clearly labelled "两种位置示意". Early deviation uses muted blue, late uses muted red.
Bottom left ET curve: horizontal axis completion C, y-axis loss; a continuous piecewise-linear curve decreases to zero at e, is zero over [e,d], then increases after d. Connect blue interval [C,e] or red [d,C] in the magnification to matching curve locations.
Bottom middle count curve: a discontinuous multi-step function, descending in tiers as C approaches e from the left, zero on [e,d], ascending in tiers beyond d. Label "普通计数为单档特例". Show open/closed endpoint dots at jumps. NEVER render the count loss as a V curve or a continuous ramp.
Bottom right work curve: FIX a processing duration p and window width larger than p. Show a left plateau, descending linear or multi-slope segment between e and e+p, zero only on [e+p,d], ascending linear or multi-slope segment between d and d+p, then a right plateau. Label axis breakpoints e, e+p, d, d+p correctly ordered. The magnification shades the ACTUAL processing overlap before e as EW, after d as TW; these shaded pieces are inside [S,C]. CRITICAL: completion inside [e,d] can still have early work if S<e. Include a short label "EW≠提前时间". Do not give invented numerical values.
Shared bottom legend "彩色块：加工｜灰虚线：可承诺范围｜绿色：选定窗口｜蓝：提前损失｜红：拖期损失". Focus on legible mathematically correct flat diagrams with uniform notation.
